caption: Land Use Capability classes, Gisborne–East Coast Region, sheet 1, published in 1967 at 1:126,720. C. S. Harris and J. G. McKee classified land from arable classes I–IV to protection land in Class VIII. This earlier regional survey predates the national NZLRI mapping of 1973–1979. Sourced from LINZ. context: The catalogue describes six sheets: two LUC class sheets by C. S. Harris and J. G. McKee, two recommended-land-use sheets by C. S. Harris, and two rock-erodibility sheets by T. N. O’Byrne. This image is LUC classes sheet 1 only. Drawn by the Department of Lands and Survey and published in Wellington in 1967, the map bears 1964 in its title and a one-inch-to-two-miles scale (1:126,720). The University of Auckland made the electronic reproduction of a LINZ original in 2014; the catalogue records a 600 ppi TIFF archive. The currently delivered archival file is JPEG 2000, 18,557 × 17,240 pixels. The downloadable local JPEG is the unchanged 4,640-pixel IIIF access copy. The full archival download is linked under Original source file. The 1967 map documents the eight-class Land Use Capability scheme and predates the first-edition NZLRI mapping programme of 1973–1979.
